chk_sync_rows.name: chk_sync_rows
chk_sync_rows.value: ("student_sync_jobs"."processed_rows" IS NULL OR "student_sync_jobs"."processed_rows" >= 0) AND ("student_sync_jobs"."error_rows" IS NULL OR "student_sync_jobs"."error_rows" >= 0)

chk_workshops_price.name: chk_workshops_price
chk_workshops_price.value: ("workshops"."is_paid" = false AND "workshops"."price" IS NULL) OR ("workshops"."is_paid" = true AND "workshops"."price" > 0)

chk_tickets_void.name: chk_tickets_void
chk_tickets_void.value: ("tickets"."status" = 'ACTIVE' AND "tickets"."voided_at" IS NULL) OR ("tickets"."status" = 'VOID' AND "tickets"."voided_at" IS NOT NULL)
